data.gender_notes: Gerianna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gerianna is derived from the Greek name Geras, which means 'age' or 'year'. The addition of the suffix -anna makes the name mean 'little Geras'. This name is associated with the Greek goddesses Geras and Geranios, who symbolized old age, wealth, and prosperity. In the Christian tradition, Gerianna may be seen as a name representing joyful, serene, and graceful qualities.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerianna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
